description: This file implements health check and reporting functionalities for a gateway, including gathering status of channels, agents, sessions, and performing probes. It contains functions for generating health snapshots and a command for outputting health info.

methods.name: formatDurationParts
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string with units (ms, s, m, h, d, w).

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatSummary
methods.description: Resolves the heartbeat summary for a given agent ID using configuration.

methods.name: resolveAgentOrder
methods.description: Determines the order of agents based on configuration, ensuring default agent is included.

methods.name: buildSessionSummary
methods.description: Builds a summary of sessions from a session store path, including recent activity.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Safely casts a value to a record object if possible.

methods.name: inspectHealthAccount
methods.description: Inspects a channel account, either via plugin config or read-only inspection.

methods.name: readBooleanField
methods.description: Reads a boolean field from a record object.

methods.name: resolveHealthAccountContext
methods.description: Resolves account context including enabled and configured status, with diagnostics.

methods.name: formatProbeLine
methods.description: Formats a probe result into a human-readable status line.

methods.name: formatAccountProbeTiming
methods.description: Formats timing info from a channel account health summary.

methods.name: isProbeFailure
methods.description: Determines if a probe result indicates failure.

methods.name: formatHealthChannelLines
methods.description: Generates human-readable lines summarizing channel health statuses.

methods.name: getHealthSnapshot
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive snapshot of current health status of gateway, channels, agents, and sessions.

methods.name: healthCommand
methods.description: Command to perform health check, outputting JSON or formatted report, with debug and verbose options.
